metadata.title: Nvidia Stock: DeepSeek Wants to Bypass US Sanctions With a Custom Chip<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
DeepSeek Wants to Bypass US Sanctions With a Custom Chip. Why Nvidia Stock Is Sliding.
Nvidia stock was falling again early Tuesday. It’s the same old worry about big customers developing their own chips—but this time in China.
